# Broken Fixture Repository

A sample repository designed to verify onboarding failure detection.

## Requirements

- Node.js 20+
- npm

## Quickstart

Follow the instructions below to get started.

### 1. Clone the repository

```bash
git clone https://github.com/example/broken-fixture.git
cd broken-fixture
```

### 2. Architecture Overview

This project includes a backend server, database migrations, and an API.
Please ensure Node.js is installed.
For additional debugging, check the issue tracker.
Contributors should adhere to the code of conduct.
All changes require passing test suites.

### 3. Install dependencies

Run the package manager installation:

```bash
npm install
```

### 4. Run tests

To run the verification test suite, execute:

```bash
npm test
```

### 5. Deployment

Production builds are handled via CI.
